notes.title: Weekly Update #16 - Let's Talk About Act 4 & Release Dates
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/4436db186c9e45d7ca304d07f424b6f4a37e5d77.gif[/img]

It’s Gamescom week, Parasites, and this week’s update is the largest one to date. We’ve got a ton of stuff to get through including new content (did we mention Act 4 is now complete?), what’s happening at Gamescom, release date news and much more. Shall we begin?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/74f3a0af6908e2804948be1efc257506cdfd2614.gif[/img]

[h1]What’s NEW in 0.1908.1[/h1]

[list][*]Completed Act 4: The Desert.
[*]Completed The Desert level.
[*]Added new themed rooms to The Desert.
[*]Added new secrets to The Desert.
[*]Added Area 81 sublevel with new character classes, themed rooms, traps, secrets etc.
[*]Added a brand new character class (as playable and AI character): the Alien Creature.
[*]Added a brand new character class (as playable and AI character): the Researcher.
[*]Updated & added character descriptions in the Almanac.[/list] 

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed quicksand traps.
[*]Fixed Space Huntress’ primary attack.
[*]Fixed Space Huntress’ special attack.
[*]Fixed Pyromaniac’s special attack.
[*]Fixed characters’ GUI.
[*]Fixed Werewolf Pre Attack (as miniboss).
[*]Fixed miniboss rooms unlocking behavior.
[*]Fixed some Old Sewers rooms.
[*]Fixed Third Boss shop room.
[*]Fixed Fourth Boss shop room.[/list]

[b]NEW TRAILER ALERT FOR ACT 4![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vhh7Fcds_B4&feature=youtu.be

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/ba968bd9a44056400506677e225619d1b8a131d4.gif[/img]

[h1]Gamescom 2019[/h1]

We’re here! We made it to Gamescom and Saverio (the boss Parasite here at Troglobytes HQ) is on hand with this brand new build of HyperParasite. Everything above is ready and waiting.  We can’t wait to show press, influencers and visitors what we have been working on implementing. Come and visit us in Hall 10.1 in the Entertainment Area of the Spanish Pavilion. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33190580/014783816343cf2128cb3b252805485f32020bbb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Release Date Update + New Price[/h1]

Since we released HyperParasite on Steam Early Access, the game has received weekly updates including two complete brand new acts, developer and community gameplay streams, a shit ton of new characters, levels, mini-bosses, BIG bosses, gameplay mechanics and quality of life features. As we continue to add more and more to the game, we feel it’s now the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99. Boss Parasite Saverio released the following statement to the video game press earlier today; 

“With the implementation of Act 4, we feel it’s the right time to increase the price from $10.99 to $12.99, which we feel still offers incredible value for money. If you’re at Gamescom, we’d love to show you how far our game has come along in development since our initial Early Access release!”

In addition to the pricing update, we’re also announcing that our planned full, and final, release for HyperParasite will now be Q1 2020. This gives our team the time required to complete not just the Steam build, but the Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch build too. We’ll continue to keep you updated here via the Steam store page and [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]here on Twitter[/url]. 

[b]Wishlist now![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/838110/HyperParasite/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/17531bc104659dbb815b96d81c98f16636eac4e8.gif[/img]

[h1]WEEKLY STREAM[/h1]
It’s Gamescom week, so things are MAD busy here. We’ll be doing our best to do some live streaming here on Steam, so keep an eye on our [url=https://twitter.com/_Troglobytes_]Twitter[/url] account for live updates. 

Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/troglobytes/]Twitch[/url] too!

If you’re a streamer on Mixer, and want to be hosted by Hound Picked’s new channel, whilst getting hands on with HyperParasite, then let us know hyperparasite@houndpicked.com. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/0ed2ccefdae60f979600cdf6a09760ccc6352533.gif[/img]

[h1]COMMUNITY NEWS[/h1]

Don’t forget about the brand new [url=https://hyperparasite.gamepedia.com/Hyper_Parasite]HyperParasite Wiki[/url], which went live last week, thanks to our friends over at GamePedia. Since launch, it’s been updated with all the character descriptions and weapon info, with more to come in the following weeks.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747280/a1baed1d03a759f0952b36395bfc86c6cecb6bc0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Price Drop! New Trading Cards, Achievements and bug fixes for Dystoria!
notes.notes:
[h1]Price Drop![/h1]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

We've added 12 new achievements! Check them out on the Dystoria page to find out how to earn them.

[h1]Trading Cards[/h1]

There are now 7 new trading cards for you to collect featuring some of the ships of Dystoria! This also includes badges for collecting full sets and emoticons.

[h1]What's New in Dystoria[/h1]

New: In the map view - added labels to ship, orbs and exit.
New: Labels on badges so you know how to earn each one.
New: Minor level edits to smooth out congested areas.
New: Dialogue is now skippable

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]

Fixed: Map view, parts of the level disappearing.
Fixed: Kryoccian 2 Endless death loop - spawning at a checkpoint and being attacked by enemy before level start.
Fixed: Level stats not saving highest scores.
Fixed: Embryis 7 Nucleon stats incorrectly reported.
Fixed: Time counter occasionally not stopping when player dies
Fixed: Enemies moving through walls in some sectors
Fixed: Zuruli 2 Exit lauched ship into a transporter
Fixed: Enemies attacking after you exit sector
Fixed: Shield/health continue to drop if entering a transporter while under attack
Fixed: Enemies firing when player not visible
Fixed: Mouse icon appears during boss fight
Fixed: Miscalculation of some level stats (Nucleons and enemies)

Many more minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Feb 8 Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who has been submitting bugs and suggestions. You guys rock, and we've been listening to everything you say and making changes based on your feedback. 

We've been working hard to hammer out the last of the little details before launch. Check it out!


[H1]UPDATES:[/H1]

-Abduction Cut Scene, now shows UFO joining up with the mothership.
-Added Graphics options to menu
-Added Keyboard and Gamepad remapping
-Added Difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard, insanity) May need balancing
-Added Time to level complete menu
-Changed some player stats to percentages instead of fractions
-Added soundfx to boss projectiles
-Added new ship (Quadrex)
-Balanced Ship Specs
-Balanced weapons
-Unlocked first 2 ships at beginning of game
-Map view highlights ship, orbs, and exit locations.
-Added beta testers to end credits


[H1]FIXES:[/H1]
-Issues with controller sensitivity in substation on New Game (only affects some systems - needs testing)
-Bombs explode while game is paused
-Using map view after entering exit portal caused "Ship Decoupled" and would fail the sector.
-Mouse Icon shows up after dialogue in Boss level
-Cutscene-Flickering light stayed on after arcade cab disappered
-Substation Menu, launch button disappeared when tabbing back through ship select menu.
-Wrong Nucleon and Enemy count in some sectors
-Menu glitch allowed unlocking weapons without sufficient Nucleons.
-Nexus Ship had wrong texture
-Solterria 3 Camera didn't follow ship
-Embryis 6 Laser field out of alignment
-Grammar errors in some dialogue
-Transporter out of alignment in Embryis 6

notes.title: DYSTORIA Beta Testing - Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you to all of you who have been beta testing Dystoria![/h1]

Today we have released a [b]major update[/b] that brings Dystoria from 10 Levels to 29 Levels, adds new music, weapons, ships, story revamp and a huge pile of bug fixes based on the feedback that we have had so far.

There are also some [b]performance enhancements[/b] that will give people with lower spec computers a significant increase in frame rate and overall smoothness of gameplay.

[h1][b]***Please Note*** [/b][/h1]
If you have previously been playing Dystoria, this update will break your save file which will cause issues throughout the entire game. To fix this, please start a new game after you get this update.

As always, if there's any bugs that you spot, please let us know on our [url=http://www.dystoria.com/community/]Forum[/url] and we will post fixes ASAP.

[h1]Known issues we are currently addressing:[/h1]

Incorrect music plays in some sectors
Missing Weapon "Regenerator"
Weapon Loadout Menu Secondary Weapon sometimes disappears from Loadout
Occasionally Ship Speed, Handling and Camera Settings fail to initialize at the beginning of the level. (Pause and Unpause works as a temp fix)
